fields.title: Relief Material Distribution Coordinator
fields.location: Wayanad District Relief Camp, Sulthan Bathery
fields.description: Coordinate distribution of food packets, water bottles, and essential supplies to 500+ families at the relief camp.

fields.title: Medical Support Team Member
fields.description: Provide first aid support and assist medical professionals in treating minor injuries and illnesses among flood victims.

fields.title: Temporary Shelter Setup Assistant
fields.description: Help set up temporary shelters with tents, bedding, and basic amenities for displaced families.

fields.title: Mathematics Tutor for Class 8-10
fields.description: Conduct mathematics classes twice a week for students in classes 8-10. Help with homework and exam preparation.

fields.title: Art and Craft Workshop Facilitator
fields.description: Organize weekly art and craft workshops to develop creative skills among children aged 6-14.

fields.title: Patient Registration Volunteer
fields.description: Manage patient registration, maintain records, and guide patients through the medical camp process.

fields.title: Pharmacy Support Assistant
fields.description: Assist pharmacist in organizing medicines, dispensing prescriptions, and maintaining inventory.

fields.title: Food Distribution - Sunday Community Kitchen
fields.description: Help prepare and distribute free meals to homeless individuals and daily wage workers every Sunday morning.
